rambling, unmoored and unserious. 
in way over his head.

us allies deeply concerned by the 19 minute iran speech from the commander in chief.
trump speech absolutely not what markets were hoping for.

zero talk of us-iran negotiations so far. 

all about unilateral military strikes/solution.

next 2-3 weeks, we will hit iran extremely hard, bomb them back to the stone ages. 

key quote that moves markets so far.

big if true. 
granted, not true. 
but big if true.

obama giving iran so much cash.

though much less that iran now making with us suspended sanctions on oil.

“we’re now totally independent from the middle east.” 

would be nice to see a better understanding of interdependence and the global marketplace.
